article.story: MISSOULA, Mont. -- — Money Williams' 31 points led Montana over Cal Poly 90-82 on Friday. Williams added six assists for the Grizzlies (4-1). Tyler Isaak scored 19 points while going 5 of 11 from the floor, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and 7 for 8 from the line and added seven rebounds. Brooklyn Hicks had 14 points and shot 5 of 11 from the field, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 3 for 6 from the line. Peter Bandelj led the Mustangs (2-3) in scoring, finishing with 21 points. Cayden Ward added 15 points and six rebounds for Cal Poly. Jake Davis had 14 points, six rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
